definitions.explanation: A number expressed as a ratio of two integers (numerator over denominator).

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{分数|ぶんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned fractions in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {分数|ぶんすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通分|つうぶん}→通分：30689_tsuubun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Adding fractions requires putting them over a common denominator.
Written as a fraction, one half is 1/2.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{分子|ぶんし}→分子：11769_bunshi⟧ - numerator (top number)
- ⟦{分母|ぶんぼ}→分母：15936_bunbo⟧ - denominator (bottom number)

TYPES:
- ⟦{真分数|しんぶんすう}→真分数：30691_shinbunsuu⟧ - proper fraction (numerator < denominator)
- ⟦{仮分数|かぶんすう}→仮分数：30692_kabunsuu⟧ - improper fraction (numerator ≥ denominator)
- ⟦{帯分数|たいぶんすう}→帯分数：30693_taibunsuu⟧ - mixed number

OPERATIONS:
- ⟦{通分|つうぶん}→通分：30689_tsuubun⟧ - finding common denominator
- ⟦{約分|やくぶん}→約分：30690_yakubun⟧ - reducing/simplifying fractions

RELATED MATH TERMS:
- ⟦{整数|せいすう}→整数：04328_seisuu⟧ - integer
- ⟦{小数|しょうすう}→小数：27356_shousuu⟧ - decimal
- ⟦{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}→百分率：24428_hyakubunritsu⟧ - percentage

HOW FRACTIONS ARE READ:
Japanese names the denominator first: 1/2 is ⟦{二分|にぶん}→二分：30504_nibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (literally 'one of two parts'), and 3/4 is {四分|よんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧. This is the reverse of the English order, and it is the single most common stumbling block for learners meeting the word.
